prOriginal.nota: Found by searching the linked issue #40368 / commit title 'Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently'. The PR's single commit is the benchmark head 4def149a50; merged into main as 332c9b6e4a. Backports #41021 (26.3) and #41020 (26.2).

fix-concurrent-group-access-to-prevent-n.reason: On keycloak main today, infinispan GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() still reads `GroupModel model = modelSupplier.get(); return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`, identical to the benchmark head, while GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() Javadoc still says 'Never returns null'. Later commits to GroupAdapter (import order, organization groups, SCIM) did not touch this method.

The test createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti on main still starts the reader with `new Thread(...).start()` without keeping or joining it, and asserts caughtExceptions immediately after deletedAll.set(true). Later commits only added @DatabaseTest/@DisabledForDatabases("mssql") annotations and import changes; the race is unchanged.

On main the deletes still run in a plain forEach followed by deletedAll.set(true), with no try/finally, so a failing remove() leaves the non-daemon reader thread looping. No later commit to GroupTest.java changed this test body.
